drivingQuestion: Does R' Eliezer's 'two side posts' include a cross beam?
outcomeNote: The unit ends with the dilemma raised; its treatment continues beyond this packet.

segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר לְחָיַיִן. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר לְחָיַיִן וְקוֹרָה קָאָמַר, אוֹ דִילְמָא לְחָיַיִן בְּלֹא קוֹרָה קָאָמַר?
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabbi Eliezer says:» Two «side posts» are required. A «dilemma was raised» before the Sages: Did «Rabbi Eliezer» intend to «say» that two «side posts and a» cross «beam» are required, adding a stringency to Beit Shammai’s opinion, that in addition to the cross beam not one, but two side posts are required? «Or perhaps he» intended to «say» that two «side posts without a» cross «beam» are required.
